changes.title: Species attacks
items: Every creature has its own attack now, each shown before it lands: rings of quills, rolling logs, homing feathers, frost rings, rainbow tethers, icicle rain and more, wilder on the further islands (?attacks=old for the old ones)

changes.title: Crown spiral
items: The great oak's lights now wind round its crown in two long strands, spiralling out from the middle and sagging across the gaps

changes.title: Wide roots
items: The jungle cave's giant kapoks and strangler figs stand on their roots on a slope, no longer hanging their buttresses over the ground below
